humanLanguage.description: The language of reports and questions to the human, the `--human` file of `ogw loop end-record` and the `--reason` file of `ogw build report`. BCP 47 language tag

agents.description: Agent CLI, model and effort per role. The lead agent is not here, because it is a session that a human started

hosts.description: Values that differ per host. The key is the host id, and `## host` of [ogw](../tools/ogw.md) defines the host id

instanceWaitTimeoutMs.description: The maximum duration that ogw instance start waits for a slot when the number of concurrent instances is maxConcurrentInstances

jobWaitTimeoutMs.description: The maximum duration that ogw job wait and ogw agent wait keep waiting without --timeout. It is shorter than the longest time limit that the agent CLI of the lead agent and of agents can give one shell call

paths.description: Path relative to the workspace root. The workspace root is the parent folder of this repo

worktrees.description: The folder of the game repo worktrees that the harness tool creates. Kept outside games

coreReleaseRepository.description: The GitHub repository that publishes core releases. <owner>/<repo>

minCoreVersion.description: The lowest core version of a game that this harness supports; null supports every version up to the core version of the harness (AGENTS.md `## repo`)

useLocalCore.description: When true, the harness tool uses the core in paths.coreImpl instead of the release of the game's core version. AGENTS.md `## repo` defines the behavior

resourceGeneration.description: Generation methods that the resource sub-agent can use

backgroundRetryLimit.description: The maximum number of times one failed resource work item or translation work item is given again to a new sub-agent. It is also the maximum number of times `ogw loop evaluate` calls one failed play agent or judge agent again, and the maximum number of times `ogw agent retry` calls a failed content agent again

webSmokeCpuThrottleRate.description: The CPU throttle factor that build-time check `web smoke` applies to the headless browser. It is the `rate` of Chrome DevTools Protocol `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate`. 1 is no throttle

webSmokeBootTimeoutMs.description: In build-time check `web smoke`, the time limit from opening the page until `boot_stage` of the client becomes `Done`

loopStop.description: Values of the loop stop judgement. `## stop` of the `game-loop` skill defines their meaning

plateau.description: The number of consecutive iterations of `plateau`

successJudges.description: The number of success confirmation judges

loop.description: Values of the loop iteration kinds and the step 4 judges. `## iteration` of the `game-loop` skill defines their meaning

funIterations.description: The number of fun iterations in a row after which the next iteration is a completeness iteration

judgeVotes.description: The number of step 4 judges of an iteration with a baseline game

judgePanel.description: Agent CLI, model and effort of the step 4 judges in turn. Empty: every judge uses `agents.judge`

variants.description: The number of variants the content agent makes in a fun iteration

reviewRounds.description: The maximum number of review rounds for one target in code review. [core command](../skills/core/command.md) and `## update harness tool` of [ogw](../tools/ogw.md) define the round

codeCheck.description: Criterion values of `ogw code check` and static check `lint`

maxComplexity.description: Upper limit of the ESLint `complexity` rule of the TypeScript lint

rigCheck.description: Pass criterion values of `ogw resource rig-check`. `production.md` of the `resource` skill defines how they are measured

iouMin.description: Lower limit of the alpha IoU between the parts recomposed in rest pose and the source illustration scaled to the canvas of the rig split JSON

colorDiffMax.description: Upper limit of the mean RGB channel difference measured on pixels that are opaque in both. 0 to 255

tools.description: Pinned versions of the external programs and container images that the harness tool and agents use, other than the engine and the `buildTools` of core release `engine.json`. Programs, images and versions that are not here are not fetched

postgresql.description: The Docker Official Image `postgres` of PostgreSQL. Fetched as `postgres:<tag>@<digest>`

tag.description: Image tag that is the PostgreSQL version. `<major>.<minor>`

digest.description: The multi-platform image index digest of that tag

chromium.description: The headless browser that build-time check `web smoke` and the browser run of client core tests start. It is `chrome-headless-shell` of Chrome for Testing

gdtoolkit.description: The PyPI `gdtoolkit` wheel that holds the GDScript lint `gdlint`, and the wheels it depends on. `ogw` makes an isolated environment of the `python` version with uv, installs only these wheels without dependencies, and runs it

ffmpeg.description: The ffmpeg static build that the sound post-processing of `ogw resource finalize`, `ogw resource placeholder`, `ogw frames`, the app icon conversion of `build` and the post-processing of the sprite-gen method use. When the `-encoders` output of the fetched program has no `libvorbis`, `ogw generation install` treats it as not fetched

name.description: The host name of that host. It is the name by which a human recognizes the host

maxConcurrentInstances.description: The maximum number of instances started concurrently on this host. The `host-env` skill sets the value. When it is missing, there is no measured value, and the `ogw` commands that start instances, other than `ogw instance measure`, fail without starting an instance

playInstances.description: The number of instances that play agents play in parallel on this host each iteration

reviewRunConcurrency.description: The maximum number of review agent jobs, core agent jobs and core test jobs that all `ogw review run` jobs running on this host run together

testDevices.description: The android devices connected to this host that the check device performance at build uses for android builds

serial.description: The device serial that adb devices outputs. An emulator also works

imageMethod.description: The method that makes the image types of a game whose images no method has made yet (`## method` of [production](../skills/resource/production.md)). The name of a `resourceGeneration` method whose `resourceTypes` has `image`. The `host-env` skill sets it with the human

measured.description: Results per method and per step that `ogw generation measure` measured on this host. The key is the method `name` of `resourceGeneration`. Steps go from the lowest, and stop at the step that fails or exceeds the safety limit. A method that is not present is a method not measured on this host. Only `ogw env propose --apply` writes it

kind.description: external-service: a generation service of an outside company. local-model: a generation model that runs on this host. procedural: the agent makes it with code or a program. catalog: chosen from a set of files fetched by pins

resourceTypes.description: The resource types that this method makes. They are values of the resource key `<type>` of the `resource` skill

secret.description: The harness secret name used for API calls of the external service. Only an external-service without `provider` uses the `secret` of a method

provider.description: The image provider of an external-service method. It is the `--provider` value that the method passes to the CLI of the git repository of `pins`, and that CLI uses the login of the provider on this host (`ogw env check` reports it, and whether calls are billed per call). A method with a provider does not use `secret` or `model`

pins.description: Pinned information of the files that local-model, catalog and an external-service with `provider` fetch. Except for the packages that a local-model pip pin depends on, repositories, files and packages that are not here are not fetched

model.description: The exact name of the model that an external-service without `provider` uses. Use a name with the version attached

license.description: The license of resources made with this method. An SPDX license expression, and `unknown` when commercial use is not confirmed. Required for kinds other than `catalog`

attribution.description: The attribution that must be displayed for resources made with this method. Omitted when there is none

safetyTimeoutMs.description: When one standard trial task of `update env` exceeds this duration, it is cut off and recorded as `timeout`

kind.description: git: repository. hf: Hugging Face repository. pip: package. file: one model file. patch: a patch file in this repo to apply to the preceding git repository

source.description: For git the repository URL, for hf the repository name, for pip a comma list of `name==version` (`name @ git+URL@commit` also works. A name can carry extras `[a,b]`, and the end can carry a PEP 508 marker ` ; <marker>`; commas inside extras and inside the quotes of a marker do not split the list), for file the model name, for patch the path relative to this repo

url.description: The URL from which the file of a file pin is fetched. Used only for file pins, and required for file pins

revision.description: The 40-character commit of git and hf. A git pin without it is not fetched, and `ogw env propose` proposes a revision

files.description: For hf a comma list of file patterns to fetch (the whole repository when missing), and when no file matches after removing `exclude`, the method of that pin fails. For file the file name under which to put the fetched file, for git a comma list of paths inside the repository to fetch (the whole repository when missing). An hf pattern matches the whole file path relative to the repository root. `*` matches any string of characters including `/`, `?` matches one character, and any other character matches only itself

exclude.description: A comma list of file patterns to exclude from hf. The pattern rules are the same as `files`

sha256.description: For file the SHA-256 of that file. For hf the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text that joins, in the UTF-8 byte order of the paths, one line per fetched file made of `<path relative to repository root> <lowercase hex SHA-256 of that file>` followed by one LF. For patch the SHA-256 of that file. An hf pin without it fetches files without checking them, and `ogw env propose` proposes a revision

secret.description: Used only by hf pins. The harness secret name that holds a Hugging Face access token. The token belongs to an account that accepted the license of that repository. `ogw generation install` sends that token with the Hugging Face API requests and downloads of this pin

pyproject.description: Used only by git pins. The path, relative to the repository root, of the `pyproject.toml` that the method uses. `pyproject.toml` when missing. `pin:<method>` of `ogw env propose` reads `[project] dependencies` of this file

python.description: The CPython version `<major>.<minor>` of the isolated environment. The platform wheels of `downloads` and `dependencies` are wheels of this version

downloads.description: The wheel of that program. Its platform is `any`

dependencies.description: All wheels that the program wheel depends on (including dependencies of dependencies). `ogw` installs the items for the platform of this host and the `any` items

resolution.description: The long side of the input or output (px)

jobMs.description: The duration that one standard trial task took (ms)
